t: This is RAK Studios, a recording studio complex with residential facilities, close to Regent's Park. It was founded in 1976 by the record producer Mickie Most, and it's used by his label, RAK Records. Most produced a long list of acts, including the Animals, Herman's Hermits, Donovan, Lulu, Suzi Quatro, Hot Chocolate and the Jeff Beck Group. So the studio carries the stamp of a producer who made hits for decades, and he built a place of his own to make them in.
